cohort: Pregnant women between 28 and 36 weeks of gestation with moderate anemia (Hb 7.1-10 g/dL) confirmed to have iron deficiency anemia.
finding: Ferric carboxymaltose (FCM) administration significantly increased Hb levels at both 2 weeks (mean increase 1.1 g/dL) and 4 weeks (mean increase 2.9 g/dL) post-infusion (p<0.001).
